Manage inventory, company records, venue bookings, and staff scheduling to support program operations effectively.

Coordinate and provide on-site support for educational events, workshops, and camps, ensuring successful implementation and operation.

Train, manage, and support trainers in implementing TGCEG’s programmes, ensuring they are well-equipped to deliver high-quality education.

Assist in reviewing, evaluating, and reporting on the effectiveness of TGCEG's programmes, including preparing reports.

Build and manage relationships with clients, program partners, and other stakeholders. This includes liaising with offices in other cities for timely updates and information dissemination.

Manage and evaluate vendors and consultants related to TGCEG's programmes, ensuring quality and efficiency.


SKILLS AND QUALIFICATIONS

Minimum  a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field

Minimum 3 year of experience in teaching; fresh graduates with relevant experience may also apply

Experience in coding, AI, or technology education (professional or teaching experience)

Competency in one or more programming languages (Python, C++ etc)

Experience in event management is a plus

Proficient in English with strong writing and communication skills

Ability to work in a dynamic, fast-paced environment

Willingness to travel for short work trips

Effective communicator, capable of engaging with diverse groups.

Resourceful with excellent problem-solving skills.

Independent, task-driven, and comfortable in high-pressure, multitasking situations.

Team player with leadership qualities and a proactive approach.

Adaptability to diverse cultural, linguistic, and work style environments.

Detail-oriented and organised.




 BENEFITS

Competitive salary

Travel opportunities with expenses covered.

Ongoing professional development.




APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS

Interested applicants should send a resume or CV accompanied by a cover letter to humanresources@theglobalcitizeneducation.com. Applications and interviews will be conducted on a rolling basis, and we will close the application once the position has been filled. All applications should be submitted in English, and any supporting documents that are not originally in English should be translated.

title: Senior Fullstack Developer

Role Overview

We are looking for a Senior Fullstack Developer who is equally passionate about  building polished, user-friendly interfaces and designing robust, scalable backend 
systems. You will own features end-to-end—from the pixel-perfect frontend in  Next.js/React to the domain-driven microservices in the backend.

- End-to-End Development: Design, build, and maintain high-performance web  applications using Next.js/React and scalable microservices using Node.js/TypeScript/Go. 
- System Architecture: Contribute to architectural decisions, including BFF (Backend for Frontend) implementation, microservices boundaries, and multitenant data models. 
- API & Integration: Build and consume clean, versioned RESTful/GraphQL APIs, ensuring seamless integration between frontend interfaces and core backend  services. 
- Scalability & Reliability: Implement event-driven workflows (Kafka/RabbitMQ), optimize for high-traffic peaks, and ensure system idempotency and failure handling. 
- UI/UX Implementation: Transform Figma/Sketch mockups into responsive, accessible, and SEO-optimized web interfaces. 
- Quality & Observability: Write testable, maintainable code, build observability (logging, metrics), and handle incident resolutions. 
- Collaboration & Mentorship: Work closely with Product, Design, and QA teams. 
- Review code and mentor mid-level engineers to uphold engineering standards. 
- Professional Experience: Minimum 6+ years of experience in backend  development, with at least 3+ years focused on modern web frontend  technologies. 
- Frontend Stack: Expert knowledge of Next.js, React, HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript/TypeScript (ES6+). 
- Backend Stack: Proficient in Node.js, TypeScript, or Go. Strong experience with NestJS or similar frameworks is a plus. 
- Architecture: Solid understanding of Microservices, BFF, and Distributed Systems concepts. 
- Database & Messaging: Hands-on experience with Relational Databases (PostgreSQL/MySQL), Caching (Redis), and Message Brokers  (Kafka/RabbitMQ/PubSub). 
- Tools: Mastery of Version Control (Git) and familiarity with CI/CD pipelines. 
- Soft Skills: Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and excellent communication in English (both written and spoken).

Nice to Have Experiences
- Experience with Tailwind CSS, Bootstrap, or building custom UI Component Libraries. 
- Knowledge of real-time systems (WebSockets, SSE, MQTT).

title: Back-End TypeScript Developer
job_description:
Ready To Build Something Real?

John Galt Services seeks a full-time Back-End TypeScript Developer to serve a US customer building a construction project management platform used by contractors across the United States.

This is a production SaaS product with real users and real money flowing through it: proposals, invoices, purchase orders, budgets, vendor payments. The back end is a NestJS API with over 100 domain modules, multi-tenant PostgreSQL with row-level security, background job processing, AI-powered features, and integrations with QuickBooks, Google Calendar, and e-signature providers.

You won't be maintaining a legacy codebase nobody cares about. You'll be shipping features that contractors rely on to run their businesses. The codebase is modern, the architecture is serious, and the problems are interesting.

You must be fluent in English. You will join our customer's development team as a remote member with real responsibilities: not busywork.

IMPORTANT!

Your application is our first test of your attention to detail and ability to follow instructions. 👀

👉 Read this ENTIRE job listing!

👉 Follow the application instructions EXACTLY!

👉 If you do not meet the minimum qualifications for the job, DO NOT APPLY!

If you fail to follow the instructions below, we will reject your application without reading it!

Minimum Job Qualifications

FLUENT SPOKEN & WRITTEN ENGLISH! You will communicate daily with a US-based team. Your English must be clear and confident — spoken and written. If you aren't sure, keep practicing and apply next time.

SOLID TYPESCRIPT SKILLS! You don't need to be a generics wizard yet, but you must understand and value type safety. If your instinct is to slap any on everything and "fix it later," this isn't the right fit.

EXPERIENCE WITH NestJS OR SIMILAR FRAMEWORKS! The back end is a NestJS API backed by PostgreSQL (TypeORM), with background job processing (BullMQ), JWT authentication, and Docker-based deployment. You don't need to know all of these, but you should have built at least one real API with a modern Node.js framework. If the words "dependency injection" make you nervous, spend some time with the NestJS docs and then come back.

WILLINGNESS TO LEARN AND TAKE OWNERSHIP! This codebase integrates with QuickBooks, SignNow, Google APIs, and includes a RAG pipeline built on LangChain. You won't be expected to know any of these on day one, but you'll be expected to dig in and figure things out. If you need someone looking over your shoulder at every step, this role will be frustrating for both of us.

A DISCIPLINED ENGINEERING APPROACH! You write tests. You read the requirements before you code. You don't push to main and pray. We don't expect perfection. We DO expect professionalism.

You MUST have at least a Bachelor degree.

You MUST be willing to work late night hours.

You MUST either live on Bali or be willing to relocate to Bali.

You MUST have the right to work legally in Indonesia. JGS does NOT sponsor work visas!

ATTENTION TO DETAIL! The moment we see your application, we'll know.

If you do not meet ALL of these requirements, DO NOT APPLY for this job!

Nice To Have

Docker & Docker Compose

PostgreSQL / TypeORM

BullMQ or similar job queues

REST API design & Swagger/OpenAPI

AWS (ECR, deployment pipelines)

OpenTelemetry / observability

Git & GitHub Actions

Working Arrangements

You are supporting our customer remotely, but this is NOT a remote job! We will provide working space and equipment near Canggu, Bali. All work is performed on-site.

Salary & Benefits

New associates start at a probationary pay scale of IDR 8 jt / month gross (i.e. before taxes & benefits). Your probationary period is three months.

If we retain you past three months, your pay will increase to IDR 12 jt / month gross.

We pay performance bonuses based on your ability to contribute. The less hand-holding you need and the less rework your code requires, the more valuable you are to the team. After your probationary period, we will pay up to a 50% bonus for any month in which you meet or exceed our expectations. This would bring your pay as high as IDR 18 jt / month gross.

title: Senior Front End Engineer
job_description:

About Bukumed

Bukumed is a healthcare SaaS platform digitising the operations of medical facilities across Indonesia — from primary clinics and pharmacies to independent practices. We are not just software. We are building Indonesia's digital health infrastructure, integrated with SatuSehat, BPJS, and international FHIR standards.

Our product is used every day by doctors, pharmacists, and clinic staff. That means: every line of code you write has a real impact on patient care quality.

We are growing fast. We are now looking for a Senior Frontend Engineer who does not just know how to build interfaces — but knows how to leverage AI to move faster and think smarter.

The Role

You will be the full owner of the frontend experience at Bukumed. Not a spec executor — but a technical partner who shapes how the product feels and works for non-technical users in clinical environments.

You will work across modules: EMR, pharmacy management, billing, patient queuing, and SatuSehat integration. All real-time. All high-stakes.

What You Will Do

Product & Interface

Build UIs that are intuitive for clinic staff — including nurses, pharmacists, and admins who are not tech-savvy

Translate complex clinical workflows into simple, efficient user flows

Build and maintain the Bulan Design System (MUI + Figma-based) to keep the product consistent across all modules

AI-Augmented Engineering

Use AI coding tools (Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot) as a core part of your daily workflow — not a novelty

Build UI components for AI-powered features such as streaming inputs, diagnosis suggestions, and document automation

Evaluate and validate AI-generated code before it reaches production

Quality & Collaboration

Lead code reviews focused on quality, not just syntax

Collaborate directly with product, UX writing, and backend engineering (Go + PostgreSQL)

Ensure performance, accessibility, and compliance with Indonesian health data regulations (PMK, SatuSehat)

What We Are Looking For

Technical (Required)

5+ years building production-grade frontend applications

Strong React + TypeScript — hooks, state management, performance optimisation

Solid grasp of modern frontend architecture: component design patterns, code splitting, rendering strategies

Experience with REST APIs and real-time integrations (WebSocket or SSE)

Comfortable with testing: React Testing Library, Playwright, or Cypress

AI Literacy (Required)

Actively using AI coding tools as part of your daily workflow right now

Able to write effective prompts that produce accurate components and logic

Know when to trust AI output and when to write it yourself

Good to Have

Experience building UI for multi-role B2B SaaS products

Familiar with MUI, Figma-to-code workflows, or design systems

Prior experience in healthcare tech or with sensitive data environments

Experience with Next.js or other SSR frameworks

What We Are Not Looking For

Engineers who wait for perfect specs before moving

Developers who see AI coding tools as a threat rather than a tool

People who are comfortable staying only in their existing "safe zone" of technology

Our Stack

Frontend : React · TypeScript · MUI · Vite · Next.js Backend : Go · PostgreSQL · Redis Integrations : SatuSehat (FHIR) · BPJS · HL7 Infrastructure: AWS · Docker · GitHub Actions AI Tools : Claude Code · Cursor · GitHub Copilot

Interview Process

We respect your time. The process is short and relevant:

Take Home Assessment (60 min max, async) — we review code or a project you have built; no LeetCode

Phone Interview (30 min) — get to know each other; you share your experience and how you work

System Design & Live Coding (60 min) — frontend architecture discussion + one real React scenario

Culture & Team Fit — Virtual meet the product and engineering team

We will ask how you use AI in your workflow — not as a trick question, but because it is how we actually work.

What We Offer

Remote-first with full flexibility (WIB timezone overlap required)

Competitive compensation + equity as an early team member

Direct access to product decisions — your voice matters

A fast-moving environment that does not sacrifice quality

The chance to build a product used daily by Indonesian healthcare workers

Citizenship Requirement

This role is open to Indonesian citizens only. We are building a product deeply rooted in Indonesia's healthcare system — SatuSehat, BPJS, PMK regulations, and the day-to-day realities of Indonesian clinic operations. We need someone who understands this context from the inside.

How to Apply

Submit here https://forms.gle/ydWzZ9ztnzG4f9Yo9

Bukumed believes that good technology starts with engineers who care. If you want work that makes a real difference — this is it.

Pillar Technology is a provider of advanced communications solutions and a trusted supplier of telecommunications equipment to government and law enforcement agencies across Indonesia.

We are developing a web and Android platform for geoscanning of telecommunications signals — continuously collecting RF and GPS data in the field, uploading it to a backend server, and presenting operators with live signal visualisation, parameter analysis, and identification of areas of interest. The team currently comprises five engineers: backend, frontend, UI/UX, and two Android developers, working toward a production-ready release.

Qualifications

Essential

· 5+ years in Software Engineering, technical project management with a strong foundation in full stack development, or a closely related software role.

· Deep understanding of Backend (API Design/ DB management), web (modern frameworks like React) and mobile (Native or Cross-platform)

· Proven ability to write precise, unambiguous feature specifications that developers can build from independently.

· Working knowledge of software concepts — APIs, databases, frontend/backend architecture, mobile development — sufficient to hold a technical discussion and spot spec gaps.

· Hands-on agile experience: sprint planning, backlog management, and running ceremonies for a small team.

· Experience owning a QA or acceptance testing process — writing test cases, logging bugs, and making release decisions.

· Disciplined approach to documentation — feature specs, release notes, service records, and configuration logs maintained consistently throughout the project lifecycle.

· Advanced written and spoken English — specifications are the foundation of the team's daily work (please do not apply if this requirement is not met).

Nice to Have

·       Degree in Computer Science, IT, Engineering, or a related technical field — preferably from a top-tier Indonesian university (ITB, UI, ITS Surabaya, Telkom University, BINUS).

·       Background in or exposure to telecommunications, RF systems, GPS data, or geospatial platforms.

·       Familiarity with Figma or wireframing tools; exposure to SQL or data analysis.

·       Experience managing requirements for Android apps involving background services or data collection.

Key Responsibilities

Project Orchestration

· Manage the end-to-end project lifecycle, defining milestones and ensuring timely delivery.

Architectural decision making:

· Select and validate the tech stack decisions across BE, FE and Mobile. Ensure architecture is scalable, secure and maintainable.

· Define technical contracts (APIs / Databases) that allow our different platforms to communicate.

· Conduct high level code review and set engineering standards.

Feature Specification

· Write detailed PRDs defining feature behaviour in full: happy path, edge cases, error states, and explicit logic rules.

· Establish a Definition of Ready — every sprint item must have complete acceptance criteria before development begins.

· Collaborate with the UI/UX designer to validate wireframes against requirements before build starts.

Sprint & Delivery Management

· Own the prioritised product backlog and run full agile ceremonies across all five engineering streams.

· Manage the full Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) from requirements through release and post-release monitoring — ensuring each phase has clear ownership and handoff criteria.

· Track sprint delivery, surface blockers early, and manage cross-stream dependencies between backend, frontend, and Android.

· Own the release calendar, define delivery Service Level Agreements (SLAs) with the CTO, and report regularly against them.

QA & Release Sign-Off

· Own the QA process across the team — there is no dedicated QA engineer; this role fills that function.

· Conduct functional acceptance testing against the acceptance criteria you defined, before any feature is released.

· Log, prioritise, and track bugs discovered during testing back into the product backlog.

· Plan and coordinate structured User Acceptance Testing (UAT) with the CTO and end-client stakeholders; document outcomes and ensure sign-off before production releases.

· Make the go/no-go call on each release — you are the final quality gate before a build ships.

Technical Collaboration & Stakeholder Communication

· Work with engineers to understand how functional requirements affect the system — APIs, data flows, background service behaviour, upload reliability — without writing production code.

· Identify when a seemingly simple functional change carries significant engineering cost.

· Act as the first point of escalation (L2) for operational issues reported by end-clients — triage, document, and route to the appropriate engineer.

· Maintain comprehensive documentation across the full product lifecycle: system configurations, feature specs, release notes, and service records.

· Translate CTO direction into precise developer language; translate engineering constraints into clear CTO updates.

· Produce concise sprint summaries, milestone updates, and risk assessments.

What We Offer

·       Competitive full-time compensation commensurate with experience.

·       A technically complex, mission-critical platform deployed by government and law enforcement clients.

·       High-visibility role with direct access to the CTO — your judgement will be trusted and acted upon.

·       Potential for long-term involvement as the platform scales toward full production deployment.

Apakah Anda tipe orang IT yang benci sistem yang berantakan? Apakah Anda lebih suka membangun sistem yang otomatis daripada memperbaiki printer setiap hari?

Guard (Menjaga): Menjadi "penjaga gawang" keamanan data perusahaan. Memastikan server stabil dan tidak ada kebocoran data.

Problem Solver Sejati: Anda melihat masalah sebagai tantangan untuk membuat solusi digital.

Tech-Savvy: Menguasai bahasa pemrograman (PHP/Python/JS) dan jago mengelola Database (SQL).

Security Minded: Paham cara menjaga server (Linux/Windows/Cloud) agar tahan banting dari serangan siber.

Jujur & Disiplin: Karena Anda memegang "kunci" data perusahaan, integritas adalah harga mati.

Detail Pekerjaan:

Posisi: IT System Administrator & Developer.

Gaji: Kompetitif (Sesuai dengan kemampuan dan hasil nyata).

The IT Website & Digital Systems Officer is responsible for managing, developing, optimizing, and ensuring the security and performance of the firm’s website, landing pages, tracking systems, digital forms, and automation tools used by Murzal & Partners. 1. Website Development & Maintenance

Manage the development, improvement, and updating of the firm’s website.

Create and develop landing pages for campaign and marketing purposes.

Manage and ensure proper setup of domains and hosting.

Ensure that the website remains stable, responsive, user-friendly, and professionally maintained.

Remove, replace, or adjust inefficient plugins.

Optimize cache plugins and overall website performance.

Implement defer and delay strategies for non-critical JavaScript.

Optimize render-blocking CSS.

Maintain optimal website loading speed across both desktop and mobile platforms.

Compress images based on website needs, particularly for hero images, banners, and key pages.

Resize images in accordance with layout requirements.

Implement lazy loading for below-the-fold images.

Ensure that website visuals remain high quality without compromising page performance.

Implement tag management systems such as Google Tag Manager.

Set up conversion tracking, including form submissions and other key user actions.

Ensure that all tracking data is accurate and reliable for monitoring and campaign evaluation purposes.

Identify and resolve technical SEO issues, such as crawl errors and indexing problems.

Ensure strong mobile responsiveness across the website.

Coordinate with the marketing team to support improvements in organic SEO performance.

6. Security & Data Protection

Ensure website security through the management of SSL, firewall protection, and other necessary security measures.

Safeguard and protect user, lead, and customer data collected through the website.

Conduct regular website and digital system backups.

Minimize risks relating to system disruption, data leakage, or technical failure.

7. Form & Lead Management

Create and manage digital forms, including contact forms, lead forms, and campaign-related forms.

Integrate forms with databases or reporting tools such as Google Sheets or other relevant systems.

Set up automated email responses following form submissions.

Ensure proper validation, recording, and storage of lead data.

Set up marketing automation tools based on campaign or operational needs.

Build automated notification systems via email, WhatsApp, or other relevant platforms where necessary.

Develop workflow automation across tools to improve efficiency.

Provide recommendations on tools or digital systems that may support the firm’s operations.

Understand and manage the use of Google Workspace for the firm’s operational needs, including email, Google Drive, Google Meet, Google Calendar, Google Docs, and Google Sheets.

Understand and manage Microsoft Teams for internal communication, coordination, meetings, and collaboration.

Provide technical support to internal teams regarding the use of Google Workspace and Microsoft Teams.

Assist with account setup, access control, permissions, and troubleshooting related to internal digital work platforms.

Ensure that internal collaboration platforms are used effectively, securely, and in support of team productivity.

10. Campaign & Digital Support

Support the deployment and technical implementation of digital campaigns, including banners, pop-ups, and tracking URLs.

Prepare URL tracking structures, including UTM parameters.

Assist in troubleshooting errors related to digital campaigns or landing pages.

Work closely with the marketing team to ensure campaigns run effectively from a technical perspective.

11. Reporting & Deliverables

Prepare before-and-after performance reports for website optimization work.

Monitor and report improvements in website performance, including loading speed, stability, and tracking effectiveness.

Support efforts to make the website more SEO-friendly and more effective for digital advertising purposes.

Provide bug-fixing support during the post-optimization monitoring and maintenance period.




Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related field.

Proven experience in website management, particularly WordPress.

Strong understanding of plugin management, website performance optimization, and technical SEO.

Proficiency in Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, Meta Pixel, and other relevant tracking tools.

Understanding of website security, backup systems, and data protection principles.

Ability to create and manage landing pages, form integrations, and workflow automation.

Good understanding of Google Workspace and Microsoft Teams administration.

Strong analytical skills in evaluating website and campaign performance.

Detail-oriented, responsive, capable of troubleshooting, and able to work under targets and deadlines.

Familiarity with UI/UX basics, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and marketing tool integrations will be considered an advantage.




Expected Work Output:

The firm’s website operates quickly, securely, stably, and is properly maintained.

Campaign landing pages are effectively created and deployed.

Tracking and analytics systems function accurately.

The website is better optimized for SEO and digital marketing purposes.

Form systems, lead capture, and automation processes are organized and efficient.

Internal digital collaboration platforms function properly and support team coordination.

Regular reports on website performance and improvements are available.

Competitive Salary: Paid monthly.

title: Full Stack Engineer
job_description:
About the Role

We're looking for a versatile Full Stack Engineer who can work effectively across the entire technology stack—from database optimization and backend API development to frontend implementation and DevOps deployment—for MG Bedbank's B2B travel platform.

You'll be responsible for developing and optimizing MG's supporting systems working on internal tools, admin portals, operational dashboards, data loading systems, contract management interfaces, and integration utilities that enable our business teams to manage inventory, pricing, and supplier relationships effectively.

This isn't a role for specialists who only touch one layer of the stack. We need someone who can diagnose a slow SQL query, implement the API fix, update the Angular frontend, and deploy it via Docker/Kubernetes—all in the same sprint. You'll work across the full technology landscape, collaborating with Product, Design, Backend/Frontend specialists, QA, Business teams, and our offshore partner.

This role requires:

Strong backend foundation (.NET Core/C#, SQL optimization, API design)

Adequate frontend skills (Angular, TypeScript, HTML/CSS)

DevOps capabilities (Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD)

Genuine comfort working across the entire stack[[[[[[[[[[[





What You'll Do
Full Stack Development

Build end-to-end features from database schema → backend API → frontend UI → deployment, owning the complete implementation

Develop and maintain supporting systems: admin portals, operational dashboards, data loading tools, contract management interfaces, reporting systems

Work across the stack: Database queries → .NET Core APIs → Angular interfaces → Docker deployments

Implement business logic spanning multiple layers: data validation, business rules, workflow orchestration, UI interactions

Optimize performance across the entire request lifecycle from SQL query to frontend rendering

Backend Development

Build .NET Core APIs (v6.0+ preferred) with RESTful design, proper error handling, and comprehensive documentation

Design and optimize databases: SQL Server (primary), PostgreSQL, MySQL with proper indexing, query optimization, and schema design

Implement data processing: XML/JSON parsing, ETL pipelines, batch processing, data transformations

Use Entity Framework Core (Code First, migrations, LINQ) and Dapper for data access with performance tuning

Apply clean architecture: Layered design, separation of concerns, SOLID principles

Implement security practices: Secure API design, input validation, authentication/authorization, OWASP principles

Handle async patterns: Proper use of async/await, task management, concurrency control

Frontend Development

Implement Angular interfaces translating Figma designs into functional, responsive UIs

Work with UI component libraries: PrimeNG, Bootstrap, Angular Material

Write TypeScript/JavaScript: ES6+, proper typing, component architecture

Create responsive layouts: HTML5 semantic markup, CSS3/SCSS, Flexbox/Grid

Integrate with backend APIs: HTTP clients, error handling, loading states, data binding

Debug frontend issues: Browser DevTools, performance profiling, network inspection

DevOps & Deployment

Containerize applications: Docker (multi-stage builds, docker-compose, image optimization)

Implement logging and monitoring: Elasticsearch, Kibana, Application Insights, Grafana

Troubleshoot production issues: Using logs, monitoring dashboards, and diagnostic tools

Work in Linux environments: Ubuntu command line, shell scripts, system administration basics

Collaboration & Problem-Solving

Partner with Design teams to understand UI/UX requirements and provide technical feedback on feasibility

Collaborate with Backend/Frontend specialists when features require deep expertise in specific areas

Work with QA to spec, build, test, and deploy features with proper test coverage

Support Business teams (Sales, Sourcing, Operations) by building tools that improve their efficiency

Participate in Agile ceremonies: Sprint planning, daily standups, demos, retrospectives

Conduct code reviews across the stack and provide constructive feedback

Debug large codebases systematically across multiple layers to identify root causes

Functional Analysis & System Optimization

Analyze business requirements and translate them into technical solutions spanning multiple layers

Optimize existing systems: Identify bottlenecks, refactor code, improve performance, reduce technical debt

Document technical decisions: Architecture diagrams, API specs, database schemas, deployment procedures

Propose improvements: Proactively identify opportunities for better architecture, tooling, or processes







Required Qualifications
Education, Experience & Domain

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Informatics, Information Technology/Information Systems, Software Engineering, or related technical field (preferred)

5+ years of full stack development experience with strong backend focus

Proven track record building complex systems across the entire stack—not just isolated frontend or backend work

Fluent in English (written and verbal) for distributed team collaboration

Backend Skills

3+ years .NET Core/C# (v6.0+ preferred, minimum v3.1) with production API experience

RESTful API development: Resource modeling, HTTP semantics, versioning, error handling, documentation

XML/JSON processing: Parsing, validation, transformation, serialization

Async programming: Proper async/await patterns, task management, concurrency control

SQL + query optimization: Writing efficient queries, understanding execution plans, indexing strategies

Entity Framework Core: Code First, migrations, LINQ, performance tuning, eager/lazy loading

Dapper: Raw SQL execution, performance optimization, mapping strategies

Clean architecture: Layered design, modular structure, separation of concerns, SOLID principles

Security implementation: Secure API design, input validation, authentication, authorization

Performance tuning: High-concurrency systems, caching, query optimization, profiling

Distributed systems: Microservices patterns, service communication, eventual consistency

Logging & monitoring: Structured logging, error tracking, performance monitoring

Frontend Skills

JavaScript (ES6+) and TypeScript: Modern syntax, proper typing, async patterns

HTML5 & CSS3: Semantic markup, responsive design, Flexbox/Grid, SCSS

Angular or similar framework experience strongly preferred: Component architecture, routing, services, HTTP client

Design handoff capability: Can work from Figma designs and implement pixel-accurate UIs

Debugging tools: Browser DevTools, network inspection, performance profiling

Database Skills

SQL Server (primary): Query optimization, indexing, execution plans, stored procedures

PostgreSQL or MySQL: Alternative relational database experience

Raw SQL writing: Complex joins, CTEs, subqueries, window functions

Query debugging: Ability to read execution plans and identify performance issues

DevOps Skills

Docker: Containerization, docker-compose, multi-stage builds, image optimization

Version control: Git workflow, branching strategies, pull requests, code reviews

Debugging large codebases: Systematic troubleshooting across multiple layers and services

Mindset

Ownership mentality — treats features and outcomes as your own

User-obsessed — makes decisions based on user satisfaction, engagement, and business impact

Data-driven — demands evidence before building; measures results after shipping

Quality-focused — doesn't accept "good enough" when excellence is achievable

Nice-to-Have

Travel tech, hospitality, booking engines, e-commerce, B2B platforms, transactional/payment systems, ERP, or high-volume systems experience

Offshore team collaboration experience

This role requires strong technical expertise, leadership, and a problem-solving mindset to guide our technology and engineering efforts in delivering high-quality, mission-driven products.

Before You Apply
This role is not light, routine, or heavily guided. You’ll be expected to handle ambiguity, move quickly across multiple priorities, and deliver production-ready solutions with little to no revision. You must be able to stay calm under pressure, take full responsibility for your tasks, and deliver reliable outputs — even when requirements shift mid-week or feedback requires immediate turnaround.

If you’re seeking a role that will stretch your technical capacity, sharpen your problem-solving, and accelerate your growth, and you’re prepared to meet high expectations, we want to hear from you.

Technology Leadership & Architecture: Lead the design and development of scalable, reliable technology platforms. Establish and maintain engineering standards, review technical implementations, and guide the adoption of AI, automation, and modern development practices to strengthen product capabilities.
Product Development & Innovation:Collaborate closely with product, design, and program teams to translate requirements into robust technical solutions. Contribute hands-on to the development of secure, user-friendly edtech platforms, experimenting with emerging technologies to improve product features, performance, and scalability from prototyping through deployment.
Team Leadership & Capability Building: Build, mentor, and manage a high-performing engineering organisation. Foster a culture of collaboration, accountability, and continuous learning, providing clear technical guidance, feedback, and professional development while ensuring effective resource allocation and on-time delivery.
Systems, Infrastructure & Integration:Oversee system infrastructure, architecture, and data integration to ensure reliability, security, and scalability. Support the implementation of DevOps practices, automation pipelines, and secure system design to maintain efficient and resilient platforms.

What We’re Looking For

Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field; a Master’s degree is preferred.
Leadership & Delivery Experience:4–5 years of experience working in software engineering or technical leadership roles in fast-paced environments, with experience contributing to scalable platform development. Experience in edtech, AI, or mission-driven sectors is highly valued.
Technical Expertise: Strong hands-on experience with modern programming languages and frameworks such as Python, JavaScript/Node.js, and React, along with experience using cloud platforms (AWS, Google Cloud, or Azure).
Solid background in data engineering, including ETL/ELT pipelines, data warehousing (BigQuery, Snowflake, Redshift), and scalable data architectures. Familiarity with AI/ML frameworks, APIs, automation, and system integration is highly desirable.
Core Competencies: Strong problem-solving and analytical thinking with the ability to make sound technical decisions. Excellent collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to work across teams and translate technical concepts into practical solutions.
Location & Mission Fit: Based in Bandung or willing to relocate, with a strong interest in applying technology to solve real-world education challenges.
Bonus (Nice to Have): Experience in edtech or NGO environments, familiarity with DevOps practices and CI/CD pipelines, and knowledge of data privacy regulations and secure system design.

Why Join Us?

You’ll be joining a team with a bold mission to transform education. We don’t expect perfection, but we do expect creativity, ownership, and a strong learning attitude. If you’re looking for a conventional technology role, this may not be the right fit. But if you’re ready to build innovative solutions, lead technical initiatives, and create real-world impact through technology, we’d love to hear from you.
